events.name: F1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix
events.desc: Final round of the 2026 championship, under the lights at Yas Marina.
events.where: Yas Marina Circuit, Abu Dhabi, UAE
events.about: The season closes with a twilight race that starts in daylight and finishes under floodlights. 2026 is the first year of Formula 1's new engine and chassis rules, so this finale wraps up a reset season.

events.name: Australian Open
events.desc: First tennis Grand Slam of the year at Melbourne Park.
events.about: The first Grand Slam of the season, played on hard courts in the Australian summer. Opening Week runs from 11 to 16 January, and main-draw play starts on Sunday 17 January.

events.name: Super Bowl LXI
events.desc: NFL championship game at SoFi Stadium, Inglewood.
events.about: The 61st Super Bowl decides the 2026 NFL season. SoFi Stadium hosts for the second time, after Super Bowl LVI in 2022. The kick-off time shown is the usual early-evening Eastern slot.

events.name: F1 2027 season opener
events.desc: The new season starts with a sprint weekend in Bahrain.
events.about: The 24-race 2027 calendar opens in Bahrain. For the first time a season begins with a sprint weekend, so the year's first points are scored in a short-format race before the Grand Prix.

events.name: The Masters
events.desc: First golf major of the year, played for the green jacket at Augusta.
events.where: Augusta National Golf Club, Augusta, Georgia
events.about: The only major played at the same course every year. Four rounds from Thursday to Sunday, with the green jacket presented to the winner in Butler Cabin.

events.name: FIFA Women's World Cup
events.desc: First Women's World Cup in South America, hosted by Brazil.
events.where: Brazil, final at the Maracanã, Rio de Janeiro
events.about: Brazil hosts the tenth Women's World Cup, the first in South America. 32 teams play across host cities nationwide, and the final is at the Maracanã.

events.name: Wimbledon
events.desc: The grass-court Grand Slam at the All England Club.
events.where: All England Lawn Tennis Club, London
events.about: The oldest tennis tournament in the world and the only Grand Slam on grass. Dates here follow the usual late-June start and are provisional until the club confirms them.

events.name: Ryder Cup
events.desc: Europe vs USA at Adare Manor, Ireland, in the event's 100th year.
events.about: Europe and the United States meet over three days of foursomes, fourballs and singles. 2027 marks 100 years since the first Ryder Cup, and the event returns to Ireland for the first time since 2006.

events.name: Rugby World Cup
events.desc: Australia hosts the first 24-team Rugby World Cup.
events.about: The men's Rugby World Cup expands from 20 to 24 teams and adds a round of 16. Australia hosts for the first time since 2003.

events.name: ICC Cricket World Cup
events.desc: 14-team ODI World Cup in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia.
events.about: The men's 50-over World Cup returns to southern Africa for the first time since 2003, with the field growing to 14 teams. The start date is provisional; the final is set for 21 November.

events.name: UEFA Euro 2028
events.desc: 24 nations across the UK and Ireland.
events.where: England, Scotland, Wales & Republic of Ireland
events.about: The European Championship is co-hosted by five associations across the UK and Ireland, with the final at Wembley.

events.name: LA 2028 Olympics
events.desc: Opening ceremony of the Summer Games in Los Angeles.
events.about: Los Angeles hosts the Summer Olympics for the third time, after 1932 and 1984. New and returning sports include flag football, cricket, lacrosse, squash, and baseball/softball.

events.name: Winter Olympics 2030
events.desc: Winter Games spread across the French Alps and Nice.
events.about: France's fourth Winter Games are spread across mountain clusters in Haute-Savoie, Savoie and Briançon, with ice sports on the coast in Nice.

events.name: FIFA World Cup 2030
events.desc: Centenary World Cup across Spain, Portugal and Morocco, with opening games in South America.
events.where: Spain, Portugal & Morocco + Uruguay, Argentina, Paraguay
events.about: The World Cup marks 100 years since the first tournament in Uruguay. Three celebration matches open the event in South America before the tournament moves to Spain, Portugal and Morocco.

events.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
events.desc: The next Modern Warfare campaign and multiplayer.
events.about: The next entry in the Modern Warfare sub-series, with a new campaign, multiplayer and a fresh season of live content after launch.

events.name: Phantom Blade Zero
events.desc: Kung-fu action RPG from S-Game on PS5 and PC.
events.about: A fast, combo-heavy action RPG set in a dark wuxia world, built around martial-arts animation and boss fights.

events.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
events.desc: Rockstar's return to Vice City on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
events.about: Rockstar's first new GTA in more than a decade, set in the state of Leonida and its Vice City. The release moved twice before landing on 19 November 2026.

events.name: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
events.desc: Prequel following a young Haymitch Abernathy.
events.about: Adapted from Suzanne Collins's 2025 novel, the film follows Haymitch Abernathy's Games, 24 years before Katniss.

events.name: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
events.desc: Greta Gerwig's Narnia, in IMAX before Netflix on 25 Dec.
events.about: Greta Gerwig writes and directs Netflix's first Narnia film. It plays exclusively in IMAX over Thanksgiving before streaming on Christmas Day.

events.name: Jumanji 3
events.desc: The jungle game comes back for a third round.
events.about: The third film in the rebooted series brings back the core video-game cast for another trip into Jumanji.
facts: Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black, Karen Gillan

events.name: Avengers: Doomsday
events.desc: Robert Downey Jr. returns as Doctor Doom.
events.about: The Russo brothers return to the Avengers, with Robert Downey Jr. as Victor von Doom. It opens on the same day as Dune: Part Three.

events.name: Dune: Part Three
events.desc: Villeneuve adapts Dune Messiah. Same day as Doomsday.
events.about: Denis Villeneuve's third Dune film adapts Frank Herbert's Dune Messiah, picking up Paul Atreides's story years after he takes power.

events.name: Star Wars: Starfighter
events.desc: A new standalone Star Wars story starring Ryan Gosling.
events.about: A standalone adventure set after the Skywalker saga, with Ryan Gosling leading a new cast.

events.name: Shrek 5
events.desc: The first new Shrek film since 2010.
events.about: The original voice cast returns for the first main Shrek film since Shrek Forever After, with Zendaya joining as Shrek's daughter.
facts: Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy, Cameron Diaz

events.name: The Batman Part II
events.desc: Robert Pattinson returns to Gotham.
events.about: Matt Reeves continues his crime-noir take on Batman, following the 2022 film.

events.name: Avengers: Secret Wars
events.desc: The finale of Marvel's Multiverse Saga.
events.about: The closing chapter of the Multiverse Saga, arriving a year after Avengers: Doomsday.

events.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum
events.desc: Andy Serkis directs and returns as Gollum.
events.about: A new Middle-earth film following the search for Gollum before the events of The Fellowship of the Ring.

events.name: Halloween
events.desc: Costumes, pumpkins and trick-or-treat.
events.about: Celebrated on 31 October, the eve of All Hallows' Day.

events.name: US midterm elections
events.desc: Every House seat and about a third of the Senate on the ballot.
events.about: Halfway through the presidential term, voters elect the whole House of Representatives, about a third of the Senate, and most state governors. The countdown is to the first polls opening on the East Coast.

events.name: Christmas Day
events.desc: 25 December.
events.about: Christmas Day falls on a Friday in 2026, giving many people a long weekend.

events.name: New Year 2027
events.desc: Midnight in your time zone.
events.about: The countdown runs to midnight where you are. Kiribati's Line Islands see 2027 first, about 26 hours before the last inhabited places in American Samoa.

events.name: Total solar eclipse
events.desc: Over 6 minutes of totality across Spain, North Africa and Egypt.
events.where: Spain, Gibraltar, North Africa, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Yemen
events.about: The longest total solar eclipse over land this century. The Moon's shadow crosses southern Spain and North Africa, with the longest totality near Luxor, Egypt. The countdown is to greatest eclipse.
